turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
I'm sorry? Owen. Who decided on the zero?
Tell me what you had for breakfast, then spell it backwards.
I'm not here about breakfast. Was Owen heard before that mark went in?
Then tell me something only a real mother would know about her son.
I'm not the one answering questions here, Hale. What do you have on Owen besides a checker?
